text: Hello, I'm so sorry to message this late, I know you must be busy. My stepson is 11 and has a temperature of 39.5. He keeps saying his ear hurts and holding the side of his head. He's breathing fine and his colour looks normal, lips normal too. How much paracetamol or ibuprofen can I give him at his age? I don't want to get it wrong. Also, there's a bruise on his shin, but he came off the climbing frame at the park on Saturday and remembers banging it, so I'm sure that's just that. Sorry again, his mum's away and I'm second guessing everything
